text:
**Date:** 14 March 2024, when the board's annual general meeting confirmed Henrik Dalloway as chair.

**Named person:** Priya Vennhalt, Board Secretary, who read out the confirmed appointment and recorded the vote.

**Figure:** 7 of 9 board members voted in favour of Dalloway's appointment.

**Source document/event:** The Marrowgate Water Board Annual General Meeting minutes (Ref. MWB-AGM-2024-03), published on the board's public records page.
